evidence.source_sentence: These materials were characterized in this study by NMR, UV-vis, and FT-IR spectroscopies, mass spectrometry, elemental analysis, gel permeation chromatography (GPC), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), and X-ray diffraction (XRD).
Figure 7. DSC thermograms of Rn(Th-5,4/8) and Rg(Th-m,n/p).

Thermal Transitions. Thermal transitions of regiorandom and regioregular alternating alkyl:semifluoroalkyl polymers were determined by differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) (Table 1). Representative thermograms for the series Rg(Th-5,4/p) are shown in Figure 7. A single endothermic peak on heating and a single exothermic peak on cooling were observed, which can be assigned to melting and crystallization temperatures, respectively. Thermal cycling up to $2 5 0 { - } 2 7 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$led to no noticeable decomposition.

characterizations.result_summary: XRD patterns of Rg(Th-m,n/p) homologues show sharp low-angle reflections corresponding to a well-ordered lamellar structure with interlayer distances ranging from 40.1 Å to 57.8 Å, supporting a bilayer lamellar assembly structure.

evidence.source_sentence: These materials were characterized in this study by NMR, UV-vis, and FT-IR spectroscopies, mass spectrometry, elemental analysis, gel permeation chromatography (GPC), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), and X-ray diffraction (XRD).
The solid-state structure of Rg(Th-m,n/p) was characterized by X-ray diffraction.

The X-ray diffraction patterns exhibit several sharp low-angle reflections corresponding to a well-ordered lamellar structure with interlayer distances ranging from 40.1 Å for the shortest homologue Rg(Th-5,4/4) up to 57.8 Å for the longest homologue Rg(Th-11,4/8).
